subject: SIG package: closing loop + artifact handoff for FinLytics

Cc: FinLytics Procurement <procurement@finlytics.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG kickoff — final artifact deadline 2027-04-22

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement asked me to consolidate a final list of outstanding SIG items so we can hit our internal audit window. The deadline for completion on our side is EOD 2027-04-22 (we'll be presenting to the security committee on 04/26).

Short checklist from our review:
- Completed answers for all control families (we can accept in XLS or CSV)
- Network diagram showing VPC boundaries and egress controls (PNG/PDF)
- Recent access logs sample (anonymized OK)
- SOC 2 summary or attestation pointer (if available)

Can you confirm a point-of-contact and whether you can deliver the artifacts by 04/22? If you anticipate any blocker, please call that out so we can work around it.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Moore
Security Operations Manager
FinLytics
alex.moore@finlytics.com

- 04/14: Karthik will upload the network diagram and an anonymized sample of access logs.
- 04/18: Internal check-in to resolve any outstanding control narratives.
- 04/22: Final consolidated XLS + attachments delivered to FinLytics procurement.

From: Alex Moore <alex.moore@finlytics.com>

Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff — final artifact deadline 2027-04-22

Thanks Grace and team — that timeline works. A couple of clarifications from the security committee:

1) SOC 2: a short attestation pointer + date range is sufficient for this review (we won't need the full report before 04/22).
2) For the access log sample: please remove user identifiers and keep the timestamp, action, and resource columns.
3) If possible, can you add a one-paragraph control narrative for N-3 (Ingress/Egress filtering) — the committee wants the 'why' and 'how' rather than just the list of firewalls.

We'll accept a consolidated zip on 04/22 at 17:00 PT. If anything changes we'll escalate.

Best,
Alex
